item.title: Positive Discipline, From a Parent Who Used to Yell
item.description: I was a yeller. Here is how I slowly switched to calmer, firmer discipline — the scripts that work, and what I do on the days I still lose it.

item.title: Screen Time Rules That Survived Contact With Our Actual Kids
item.description: I tried strict screen limits, screen-free weeks, all of it. Here is the imperfect system we landed on — and why the guilt spiral was the real problem.
